scope: Sector update-banner UI descriptions only; no farming or course instruction

entries.sourceEnglish: Sector illustrations have bolder arrows, larger sun symbols and a clearer map key.
entries.zu: Imidwebo yeSector inemicibisholo egqamile, izimpawu zelanga ezinkulu nokhiye wemephu ocace kakhudlwana.
entries.st: Ditshwantsho tsa Sector di na le metsu e hlahelletseng, matshwao a maholo a letsatsi le senotlolo sa mmapa se hlakileng ho feta.
entries.ts: Swifaniso swa Sector swi ni miseve leyi vonakaka kahle, mimfungho leyikulu ya dyambu ni xilotlelo xa mepe lexi nga erivaleni swinene.
entries.ve: Zwifanyiso zwa Sector zwi na misevhe i vhonalaho zwavhuḓi, zwiga zwihulwane zwa ḓuvha na ṱhalutshedzo ya mapa i re khagala nga u engedza.

entries.sourceEnglish: Sector illustrations now show bolder terrain contours and matching key lines.
entries.zu: Imidwebo yeSector manje ibonisa imigqa yokuphakama egqamile nemigqa ehambisana nayo kukhiye wemephu.
entries.st: Ditshwantsho tsa Sector jwale di bontsha mela e hlahelletseng ya bophahamo ba mobu le mela e tsamaellanang le yona senotlolong sa mmapa.
entries.ts: Swifaniso swa Sector sweswi swi komba milayeni yo tlakuka ka misava leyi vonakaka kahle ni milayeni leyi fambelanaka na yona eka xilotlelo xa mepe.
entries.ve: Zwifanyiso zwa Sector zwino zwi sumbedza mitalo ya vhulapfu ha mavu i vhonalaho zwavhuḓi na mitalo i elanaho nayo kha ṱhalutshedzo ya mapa.

entries.sourceEnglish: Sector illustrations keep richer colour, with larger labels and clearer contours.
entries.zu: Imidwebo yeSector igcina imibala egqamile, inamalebula amakhulu nemigqa yokuphakama ecace kakhudlwana.
entries.st: Ditshwantsho tsa Sector di boloka mebala e nonneng, di na le mabitso a maholo le mela ya bophahamo e hlakileng ho feta.
entries.ts: Swifaniso swa Sector swi hlayisa mihlovo leyi fuweke, swi ni malebulu lamakulu ni milayeni yo tlakuka leyi nga erivaleni swinene.
entries.ve: Zwifanyiso zwa Sector zwi vhulunga mivhala yo pfumaho, zwi na malebulu mahulwane na mitalo ya vhulapfu i re khagala nga u engedza.
